ruleset.name: CleanCodeLint
ruleset.description: PSR-12 over the package's sniff and test code, fixtures excluded. Run with `composer lint`. The call-argument indent is left to CleanCode.WhiteSpace.MultiLineStatementIndent, which `composer lint:self` and the own-source test apply, exactly as CleanCode/ruleset.xml does. Class instantiation is left to CleanCode.Classes.NewWithoutParentheses the same way, because PSR-12 demands the empty parentheses that CleanCode forbids.
